t: This is 49 Belgrave Square, a Grade II star listed house in Belgravia, finished in 1851. It was designed by Thomas Cubitt, a British master builder. Cubitt is known for developing many of London's historic streets and squares, especially in Belgravia, Pimlico and Bloomsbury. So this house is one piece of a much larger pattern of building that he shaped across the city, and the square around you is part of that same story.
